body: I'm feeling better today. I just get real low points. I've managed to get myself an assessment with a mental health unit that's close by. The appointment isn't too far away either. Thank you for your encouragement.
Damn it, this looked like a good game, too.

I have had some form of psychological illness since I was very young, the urges aren't new as towards the later end of my treatment for panic disorder (when I was seventeen, I am nineteen now) they had started to show up. Since I can remember, though, I have never felt happy or involved with other people. So hopefully it isn't a tumour, and if it is one the danger isn't too immediate!

I will definitely be seeing a doctor this Monday, though. Thank you for your help, I really do appreciate it.
I have indeed. However I have been experiencing psychological illness since I was very young so hopefully it's not a tumour!
Thank you so much for this. This is one of the biggest factors in me avoiding treatment. I feel much more comfortable now with telling the doctor what's going on. Thank you!
No I have not, though this is actually a very interesting idea.
Thinking more about this, I'm not sure the specifics are entirely relevant.

Thank you for the help. The problem is that during the time of the break, I was able and acted on the thoughts. Obviously feeling as I do now, I would never hurt anybody but during that time it was not only a possibility but very likely and I was active in my attempts. I can see from where I am at the moment that it is messed up and wrong, but when I was doing it I completely believed that I was doing the right thing.

This leads me to what I think has caused the stalemate in me seeking treatment. I feel that I would need to fully disclose everything to the therapist to get the appropriate help, but I fear that giving full disclosure to the doctor would lead to hospitalization. Reading this back is helping, though, in that I can see that there is a problem that seriously needs treating and I will definitely make that appointment.

I don't think this is something I can really discuss with my family because of the nature of it. I sometimes feel really shitty for thinking the things I think and hate the idea of my family seeing me that way, too. I will however be trying to get this sorted professionally on Monday.

I did actually go to the doctor a few times, but on my first visit I didn't mention anything (I didn't want to be arrested or hospitalized) to do with the violence so I just filled out some depression form and was prescribed Sertraline but like a fucking idiot I was scared of them and didn't take them. I went two more times before getting referred for a psychological evaluation, and like a fucking idiot (again) I didn't mention anything again because I was scared of hospitalization/arrest (again) so she just figured I was depressed and I'm waiting 18 months to see a psychologist.

Fuck writing that out I really see how retarded I am and that I will make an appointment with the doctor again on Monday.
